pipeline_wall_measurement: Recovered conservative upper bound: first invocation measured full wall minus durable source production wall; includes failed optional Git transport overhead. Individual stage walls come from durable execution logs.
timing_note: Stage walls are components of pipeline wall; any recovered conservative bound is labeled separately. Components are never added again. Analysis source/certificate checks are real additional work. Preflight exact-reference enumeration is retained in the conservative projection although formal references are reused.
transport_note: Preflight graph access uses local files. Optional fixed Git configuration reads test transport setup only. The fixed 600 s allowance also covers source transport and report overhead; formal graph access must be measured in the actual run.
memory_note: Peak is the Python process lifetime including source preparation. The short Git configuration-read subprocess is excluded; the estimate reserves at least 512 MiB for formal summaries and source transport.

source_payload_audit.scope: immutable source association only; no formal DUAL production or exact re-enumeration

known_failures: Initial optional Git transport used main repository, which lacks evidence object; preserved failed attempt and completed only missing transport/report plus current-data independent verification.
code_timing_note: Measured pipeline preceded final metadata lock and output-scan stabilization; full integration verifies final behavior. Original slower pipeline is retained as conservative projection, with independent full-population directory scan allowance.
